name: Monarch Money Investments
description: Monarch Money is a personal-finance platform that combines accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, net worth, recurring expenses, and investment holdings in one household view. Its investments experience helps customers review portfolio balances and allocation alongside the rest of their financial plan.
agentUseSummary: Investments is part of the Monarch Money consumer account rather than a separate provider, and Monarch does not publish a supported third-party account API; Relay therefore exposes no duplicate connection or agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered without a provider-supported third-party API contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Monarch Money Investments has no documented third-party account API for a bounded Relay connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Monarch Money Investments's official product and support surfaces do not publish a developer application, delegated authorization flow, account API, or webhook contract for third-party access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Monarch Money Investments publishes an official third-party developer program and documented authorization and account-data APIs.

evidence.supports: Monarch presents one consumer personal-finance platform spanning budgeting, net worth, goals, recurring expenses, and investments.
Monarch's official help center documents customer account and investment workflows but does not publish a third-party authorization or account API contract.
Monarch's service terms govern its consumer product and do not establish a distributable third-party developer integration for Relay.
